p0 + kg(0.1) +wg(h1 0.1) wgh2 = p0

where, k = density of kerosene and w = density of water.

kg(0.1) + wgh1 wg (0.1) = wgh2

800 10 0.1 + 1000 10 h1 1000 10 0.1 = 1000 10 h2

10000(h1 h2) = 200

h1 h2 = 0.01 .......(ii)

Solving Eqs. (i) and (ii), we get

h1 = 0.35

and h2 = 0.33
